subject: executor: fix the data race in hash join tests (#58406)
summary: Diff is confined to hash join spill test instrumentation: `skipProbeInRestoreForTest` is changed from a plain bool to `atomic.Bool`, with the probe worker using `Store(true)` and the test accessor using `Load()`, removing the reported data race in tests. The write is guarded by `intest.InTest` (compile-time false in normal builds), so production planner/executor semantics and concurrency behavior are unaffected. Later history on `upstream/master` keeps the same `atomic.Bool` + `Store/Load` implementation (no subsequent fix/revert for this change).
